meta_title: Unnikrishnan P: Author and Fact Checker
meta_description: Meet Unnikrishnan P, a banking and finance graduate who writes, builds and fact checks every calculator on Company Marketcap.
subtitle: Content author and fact checker for every calculator and guide on Company Marketcap.
content_html:
Unnikrishnan P is a banking and finance graduate who builds free, privacy-friendly web tools as an independent developer and designer. Company Marketcap is one of them.

What he does here

  • Content author. He writes the calculator guides and the plain-English explanations on each page.
  • Fact checker. He builds each calculator from the standard formula for its topic and tests it against worked examples with known answers before it goes live.

Education

All three qualifications were completed in India.

  • Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com), Banking and Finance, Christ University, Bengaluru (2022 to 2025)
  • Diploma in Banking and Finance, Indian Institute of Banking and Finance (IIBF), Mumbai (2021 to 2022)
  • Certificate in Securities Markets, National Institute of Securities Markets (NISM), Mumbai (2020 to 2021)

Work experience

  • Purchasing Executive, Cochin Shipyard Limited, Kochi (internship, since March 2020). Sources quotes and spare parts for ships, negotiates bulk-order prices, tracks deliveries and keeps purchase, invoice and payment records. Built a system to prevent over-ordering and another to compare the cost and quality of suppliers.
  • Gate Supervisor, Buddh International Circuit, Greater Noida (contract, July to September 2024). Ran Gate 6 at a major motorsport event, leading a team through crowd management, incident handling and guest service.
  • Assistant Gate Supervisor, Buddh International Circuit, Greater Noida (contract, July to September 2023). Coordinated gate operations and managed a team of around 30 students.
  • Customer service and digital banking associate, HDFC Bank, Bengaluru (part-time, 2023 to 2024). Helped customers at branches with UPI and net banking set-up, daily cash reconciliation, ATM transactions and self-service banking.

Skills

Banking and finance, purchasing and procurement, Microsoft Excel and Office, communication, problem solving and customer service, plus front-end development, graphic design, video editing and motion design.
